entry.note: Identified from the title page (arXiv:math/0611521v1, two authors, 22 pp, 16 sections). No ref() entry existed; ramis-sauloy2006 created 2026-09-07 by the triage. Owner upload for the Stokes / q-difference arc. No citation site yet; two cite-in-block beans queued.

relevance.rationale: The object QOU/Mathlib/QAlienBridgeEquation.lean is named after and models — a q-native alien derivation, conjugated by the dilation automorphism, with the docstring claim that the adjoint action is 'the Levi decomposition of the local q-difference Galois group, a torus of characters q^n extended by a unipotent part that the q-logarithm generates' — has its source in this paper, and the file cites only [ramis-sauloy-zhang2013] for it. Read: Abstract, §1, §2.3 (Prop 2.5 and eq. (6): the Stokes operator S_{c,d} is the ambiguity between two q-directions of summation c, d in E_q, points of the elliptic curve rather than sectors; 'case of one level' assumes two integral slopes mu < nu with delta = nu - mu), §3.1 (Thm 3.3: S_{c0,c} lies in the Stokes group St(A); Cor 3.4 its logarithm is Lie-like; Thm 3.5 DEFINES the q-alien derivations as residues of that logarithm in c, valued in the Stokes Lie algebra st(A) and graded by level, eq. (16); Thm 3.6 they are Lie-like tensor-endomorphisms of the fibre functor), §3.2 (Thm 3.8: the level-delta q-Borel transform vanishing on the block entries is a complete analytic invariant within the formal class; Thm 3.9: the q-Borel invariant maps to the alien-derivation invariant by left multiplication by a theta power), §4 (item 1: the programme of copying Ecalle's alien derivations to the q-case; items 2-3: global classification and confluence left open by the authors). Corpus-grep before judging (AGENTS.md paths 1-6): 'wild fundamental group' has ZERO hits in content/, docs/, computations/ and .beans/; 'Ramis'/'Sauloy' hits are all the RSZ Asterisque monograph or the Di Vizio-Ramis-Sauloy-Zhang survey; bean qou-vkg5 (open item 2, 'the q-native form ... whether the eigenvalue shift is additive or multiplicative is not settled') and the file's own 'Not claimed' paragraph ('exhibiting one from a resurgent q-series is untouched') are exactly the gap Thm 3.5 supplies the object for. Scope of the verdict: this paper supplies the OBJECT (the q-alien derivations and their Lie algebra) and the reading of the q-Borel kernel (Thm 3.8/3.9); it does NOT establish that QBridgeSystem's 'bridge' field holds for those derivations with any particular weight, so no aid-proof is proposed. Also relevant, one level down: RSZ-route caveat stands — §2.3 is a two-slope, integral-slope setting, and C1 at infinity is pure isoclinic (docs/audits/2026-08-08-rsz-c1-infinity-route-closed.md), so nothing here supplies C1 Stokes data.

keyResults.statement: For each q-direction c in E_q off the singular set there is a unique summation S_c of the formal isomorphism, and the Stokes operator S_{c,d} = (S_c)^{-1} S_d is the ambiguity between two directions.
keyResults.useForFolio: The q-Stokes operator is parameterised by points of the elliptic curve E_q, not by sectors — the structural fact behind the corpus's 'the Stokes data sits in the choice of theta / the theta torsor' reading (bean qou-wgnx).

keyResults.statement: The q-alien derivations are the residues in c of log S_{c0,c}; they lie in the Stokes Lie algebra st(A), decompose by level delta = mu_j - mu_i, and are Lie-like tensor-endomorphisms of the fibre functor.
keyResults.useForFolio: The source of the object QAlienBridgeEquation.lean abstracts as `alien : Omega -> Derivation R A A`; the level grading is the q-analogue of the weight grading the file's `weight` field carries.

keyResults.statement: Equation (8) has a convergent solution iff the level-delta q-Borel transform of the block entries vanishes; the q-Borel invariants and the alien-derivation invariants are related by left multiplication by a theta power.
keyResults.useForFolio: Says what the level-d q-Borel kernel formalised in QBorelKernel.lean / QBorelKernelLevel.lean is an invariant OF, and ties it to the alien derivations — two corpus files currently linked only through RSZ §3.3.

keyResults.statement: Programme: define unpointed q-alien derivations acting on q-holonomic power series, replacing Ecalle's resurgence lattice by the singular sets in the q-Borel planes at each level.
keyResults.useForFolio: The literature statement of the open q-native bridge-equation question in bean qou-vkg5 — it is open in the source too, which scopes what a corpus derivation would be claiming.
